icp: Founders, marketers, and SEO consultants who need to justify organic-search investment in commercial terms
pain: SEO forecasts often stop at traffic, leaving buyers unable to compare expected leads, profit, payback, and budget risk
revenueHypothesis: A useful public SEO ROI calculator can attract high-intent search traffic and convert qualified visitors into SearchCrew signups
mvpAcceptance: A public /seo-roi-calculator route lets visitors edit bounded traffic, conversion, value, and cost assumptions and immediately see finite year-one return and payback outputs
The calculator has keyboard-accessible exact inputs, a currency selector, reset and copy actions, a formula disclosure, explicit estimate language, and no horizontal overflow at 320px
Pure calculation tests cover defaults, zero traffic, zero conversion, immediate payback, negative return, and out-of-range input clamping
The route has canonical social metadata, FAQ and WebApplication structured data, sitemap inclusion, and links from Free Tools and the forecasting guide
The exact pushed commit passes GitHub CI and a Vercel READY preview passes the calculator buyer-path smoke test
rollback: Revert the scoped calculator commit, remove the isolated Vercel preview deployment, and leave the Cloudflare production site and domains unchanged.
stopConditions: Stop on secret exposure, target ambiguity, paid-plan requirements, production DNS changes, more than two deployment attempts, or any regression in repository CI.
